text_to_image_prompt: Create one image of A visibly elderly male werewolf clan elder in fully human form, apparent human age late 60s. Distinguished weathered broad-long face, mature forehead creases, crow's feet and subtle under-eye bags, sunken cheeks, pronounced long straight nose, thinner lips, heavy hooded slate-gray eyes beneath silver eyebrows. Dense silver-gray hair neatly combed back with receding temples, trimmed short full silver beard and moustache. Calm authoritative unsmiling expression. Deep espresso brown knee-length wool overcoat over charcoal waistcoat and tailored trousers, ivory shirt, muted dark taupe tie, small antique bronze geometric lapel pin, brown leather dress shoes. Upright tall dignified lean frame; retain credible aged anatomy. Premium semi-realistic adult otome romance-game 2.5D/3D character render with finely sculpted facial planes, dimensional eyes, individually resolved dry hair strands, subtle natural skin microtexture, physically credible wool and silk. Clean white seamless studio background, broad soft neutral frontal illumination, refined high-detail materials, no color cast, no text, labels, logo, watermark, UI, extra people, wolf ears or fangs. One landscape 3:2 sheet of three entire standing figures: exact front, strict side profile looking to screen right, exact back. Identical body, hairstyle, garments, shoes, height, crown and sole alignment. Natural relaxed stance with arms down and feet uncrossed. Men about 8.5-8.8 heads tall and women about 7.5-7.8 heads tall. All hair and soles visible, white gaps, no text.
